selection_policy: Fixed convenience sample of 25 URLs, five per publisher, finalized before the first benchmark run. Two known smoke-test regression articles, four recent FT technology-index news links, archived-era Bloomberg Nvidia news, Guardian science-day links, AP technology/space news, and NASA short/long science controls. No archive availability filtering. Not random, not representative, and not a publisher-wide coverage estimate.
